scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: critical nucleus sizes and interface energy compared to paper-reported gold with tolerances; recomputing from raw MD is infeasible in the checker sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold critical nucleus sizes and solid-liquid interface energy for pure Nb
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper, Fig. 5a and text (n* values) and text (σ = 0.367 J/m²). Digitized from the figure and cross-checked against explicitly reported values (n*=202 at 689 K, n*=2447 at 239 K, which is not directly used but confirms trend).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the published paper; values verified for monotonic consistency with the reported trend.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values from the source publication, not invented.

outputs.description: Critical nucleus size (number of atoms) at six specified undercoolings.
Average solid-liquid interface energy σ of Niobium.

output_contract.notes: The MD verification steps (melting point and liquid density) are omitted as they only validate the potential and are not required to reproduce the main headline; the EAM potential is publicly available.
